newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-KLEMENTI TP BE QUOTED WITHIN A MONTH.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-KLEMENTI TP BE QUOTED WITHIN A MONTH.

text.p: The shares of clothing company Klementi will be listed on the Tallinn stock exchange secondary list in about one month, the stock exchange said on Monday.
"Depending on how well the company's prospectus has been prepared, the quoting commission will discuss it within a week," Helo Meigas, bourse managing director, told Reuters.
"Then it takes one week to one month for the shares to get listed," she added.
Ardo Kamratov, the chairman of the board of Klementi, said that the company will hand the application to the stock exchange in the next few days.
Klementi hopes for a net profit of 7.5 to nine million kroons this year compared with 4.3 million kroons last year.
Klementi shares are currently traded on the OTC market. The price of a 100-kroon face value share has been on average 260 kroons during this month.
